# Why did my HubSpot contacts import fail?

> Free HubSpot contacts and companies CSV checker: finds duplicate and invalid emails, Excel-damaged phone numbers and ZIP codes, date format problems, bad lifecycle stage and lead status values and headings HubSpot will not match, with line numbers, and applies formatting-only safe fixes.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
